versions.changelog:
sparkbtcbot 0.3.2

- Added example scripts for common Spark wallet operations, including wallet setup, balance/deposits, payments, token operations, payment flows, and agent usage.
- Added package.json and package-lock.json for package management and dependency tracking.
- Added a bugfix note regarding tokenBalances mapping.
- No changes to core logic; update focuses on documentation and usage examples to assist developers.
Add L402 paywall support to description and trigger phrases
Address security scan: declare env vars with sensitive flag, add model-invocation reason, add production proxy guidance, improve mnemonic handling warnings, add L402 paywall support
Restructured SKILL.md — added human-friendly intro with quick example, install instructions, and examples table above the detailed agent reference.
Updated name to highlight Lightning Network capabilities — create and pay Lightning invoices using Spark.
Initial publish — Spark Bitcoin L2 wallet skill with Lightning interop, zero-fee agent-to-agent transfers, token support, and example scripts.
